course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Client and server
goal: Pass 90 as an explicit number and return 1.5 hours with server-side validation.

prerequisites.text: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: Clients handle interaction
paragraphs: Button handling, focus and dialogs belong to UI. Infobase access and reliable rules belong in an available server context. Thick and thin clients differ; local success does not prove a distributed design. Specify the target client and permitted operations before implementation.

ЧасыНаСервере receives only a number. ПроверитьЧасы reads the UI field and calls the server; neither form state nor document writing is an implicit contract. Convert the returned number to display text on the client.

sections.title: The boundary carries a contract
paragraphs: Do not send every customer to obtain one total. A server method receives minimal typed inputs and returns required data. The client cannot provide trusted permission or price decisions; the server checks its own conditions. Test serialization and parameter types separately from arithmetic correctness.
90/60=1.5 without rounding or document updates. Validate type before range 0…1440. String "90" and numeric 1441 fail different checks: type versus allowed value.

sections.title: A file infobase is not a network
paragraphs: File mode can teach client/server directives but does not fully reproduce network latency, clusters or parallel sessions. Separate compilation-context PASS from distributed LIVE. Counting source lines or one local process is not measured network-call reduction.
Create the ПроверитьЧасы form command, bind its existing action and drag it to the command bar.90 displays 1.5, or 1,5 in Russian locale; the display separator does not alter the numeric result.

sections.title: A case that distinguishes the wrong solution
paragraphs: A client hint does not replace the trusted-boundary check.

code.source: Call ЧасыНаСервере(1441) directly, bypassing the UI field.

sections.title: An availability matrix checks context
paragraphs: For each method, list caller, parameters and returned data. Test an allowed call and an unavailable operation in the wrong context. Count calls for an ordinary action. Do not fix context errors by enabling every capability indiscriminately; reduce dependencies to what is necessary.

A file-mode run proves method availability and this platform call, not network latency. Training-edition client/server limits do not prevent this local experiment. Network performance and licensed deployment require separate checks.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Form data is assumed to already be persisted. Read the actual saved reference independently before accepting persistence.
A no-context function reaches into the form object. Pass the minimal explicit input or deliberately choose the correct context.
Direct continuation tests are reported as physical dialog clicks. Record native branch coverage and actual UI interaction separately.

practice.title: Client and server
practice.task: Compare string"90" with number 90 and explain both failures.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve and select an own request
steps.action: Retain a DT and the earlier form module. Identify an own saved 30-minute request and record its actual reference.
steps.expected: The original and own copy are distinct.
steps.troubleshooting: Inspect the database path and reference; display names may coincide.
steps.before: Own path, prior sources and a restorable backup identified.

steps.title: Open the managed form module
steps.action: Append the complete source below outside earlier handlers. In the form Attributes tab add ИтогОпыта:String 120 and ВерсияЗапроса:Number 10,0 as form attributes, not document fields. Keep previous methods and one definition of each new method.
steps.why: The form owns UI state while the document schema stays intact.
steps.expected: Methods and two form attributes exist.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not add these attributes to the document metadata or paste form code into a common module.
steps.before: The original and own copy are distinct.

steps.title: Bind commands
steps.action: Add ПроверитьЧасы and УчебноеПодтверждение; select matching existing action methods and drag commands to the form command bar. For Сверить add a client action with the first example’s four lines.
steps.why: Make code reachable through explicit UI actions.
steps.expected: Commands show the intended actions without automatic startup.
steps.troubleshooting: If an action generator creates an empty duplicate, merge only its body into the existing matching handler.
steps.before: Methods and two form attributes exist.

steps.title: Check contexts and run
steps.where: Ctrl+S → Конфигурация → Проверка конфигурации → F7 → Предприятие
steps.action: Check Thin client, Server and Thick managed client. Apply changes to this copy. Open the same own request and perform the first worked example; do not press Save/Post unless the exercise explicitly asks.
steps.why: Compilation and observed behaviour are independent checks.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the method/line; distinguish a context error from a missing command binding.
steps.before: Commands show the intended actions without automatic startup.

steps.title: Record cancellation and retain work
steps.action: Call ЧасыНаСервере(1441) directly, bypassing the UI field. Retain the correct source, all observations and the unchanged original; do not claim a direct callback test is a physical dialog check.
steps.why: Separate adverse cases from accepted work.
steps.troubleshooting: Reopen the actual reference to check persisted state.
